rules.name: SLA Breach Penalty Deduction
rules.statement: The system must deduct financial penalties from the Store Partner's settlement amount when a verified SLA breach occurs.
rules.condition: when a third-party vendor fails to meet guaranteed uptime or response time thresholds defined in the SLA
exceptions: force majeure events explicitly defined in the SLA contract
breaches occurring during scheduled maintenance windows approved by the vendor
rules.if_violated: the system automatically reduces the payable settlement amount and logs the deduction reason in the immutable audit trail
rules.rationale: to financially incentivize vendors to maintain service quality and mitigate operational downtime

parameters.name: penalty_rate
parameters.description: percentage of transaction value or fixed fee deducted per minute of delay or downtime

parameters.name: threshold_duration
parameters.description: maximum allowed duration for delivery or response before a breach is triggered

rules.name: Agreement Version Locking
rules.statement: The system must prevent any modification to an active Store Partner Agreement version once a financial settlement has been finalized for that period.
rules.condition: when a Store Partner Agreement is in 'Active' status and a Financial Transaction Record has been generated for the current settlement cycle
exceptions: no exceptions; finalization triggers an immutable lock
rules.if_violated: the system rejects the change request and alerts the Platform Operator of a potential compliance violation
rules.rationale: to ensure settlement calculations remain accurate and legally defensible against retroactive changes

parameters.name: settlement_cycle_id
parameters.description: unique identifier for the specific financial period being settled

rules.name: Vendor Uptime Eligibility
rules.statement: A third-party vendor may only be eligible for revenue sharing if their historical uptime meets the minimum threshold defined in the active SLA.
rules.condition: when evaluating a vendor for inclusion in the active marketplace or for processing a new settlement batch
exceptions: vendors under probationary status with a temporary reduced threshold as defined in the contract
rules.if_violated: the system automatically suspends order allocation to the vendor until the next review cycle or manual reinstatement
rules.rationale: to prevent revenue loss and reputational damage caused by unreliable external dependencies

parameters.name: minimum_uptime_percentage
parameters.description: required percentage of operational time over the evaluation period

parameters.name: evaluation_window
parameters.description: timeframe over which uptime is measured (e.g., last 30 days)

rules.name: Dispute Escalation Trigger
rules.statement: The system must escalate a service degradation incident to the Platform Operator for manual review when a vendor breach exceeds the maximum allowable penalty cap.
rules.condition: when a calculated SLA penalty for a specific incident exceeds the maximum financial cap defined in the SLA
rules.if_violated: the system pauses automatic penalty deduction and flags the record for manual adjudication by the Platform Operator
rules.rationale: to allow human judgment in complex cases where automated penalties might be disproportionate or erroneous

parameters.name: max_penalty_cap
parameters.description: maximum financial amount that can be automatically deducted without manual review

rules.name: Real-Time Inventory Verification
rules.statement: An order must only be assigned to a store if the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot shows available quantity greater than or equal to the requested quantity for all items.
rules.condition: During order allocation to a Store Partner
rules.if_violated: The system must not assign the order and must flag it for manual review
rules.rationale: Prevents overselling and ensures order fulfillment accuracy in a high-volume environment

rules.name: Nearest Store Prioritization
rules.statement: The system must prioritize the nearest store based on the shortest estimated preparation and dispatch time when multiple stores have sufficient inventory.
rules.condition: When allocating an order to multiple eligible stores
rules.if_violated: The system must re-evaluate the allocation logic and notify the operations team
rules.rationale: Ensures the business outcome of ultra-fast delivery (typically under 60 minutes) is met

parameters.name: estimated_preparation_time
parameters.description: Time required by the store to pick and pack items (proposed)

parameters.name: estimated_dispatch_time
parameters.description: Time required for the delivery partner to reach the store (proposed)

rules.name: Immediate Inventory Lock Release
rules.statement: Inventory locks must be released immediately upon confirmation of cancellation before the Fulfillment Task status changes to 'Ready for Dispatch'.
rules.condition: When an Order Request is cancelled
exceptions: If the Order Request has already been handed over to a Delivery Partner
rules.if_violated: The system must prevent the status change to 'Ready for Dispatch' and alert the store partner
rules.rationale: Prevents inventory from being unavailable for other orders while the original order is voided

rules.name: Product Update Audit Trail
rules.statement: All product updates must include a timestamp and the identifier of the user making the change.
rules.condition: Whenever a product entry is created, updated, or archived
rules.if_violated: The system must reject the update and log the attempt as an audit anomaly
rules.rationale: Ensures accountability and traceability for catalog management decisions

rules.name: Nearing Expiry Allocation Priority
rules.statement: Perishable items approaching shelf-life limits must be prioritized for allocation to new Order Requests over items with longer remaining shelf life.
rules.condition: When allocating stock for a new Order Request containing perishable goods
exceptions: If the prioritized item is flagged as 'nearing expiry' and the system is configured to reject such orders to prevent waste
rules.if_violated: The system must flag the allocation decision for manual review and delay the order assignment
rules.rationale: Prioritizing near-expiry items minimizes financial loss from unsellable goods and maintains brand reputation for quality.

parameters.name: Shelf-life safety margin
parameters.description: The percentage or time threshold defining an item as 'nearing expiry'

rules.name: Expiry-Flagged Item Rejection
rules.statement: An Order Request must not be assigned to a Store Partner if the primary fulfillment source contains any item flagged as 'nearing expiry'.
rules.condition: When validating inventory availability for an Order Request against a Store Partner
exceptions: If the Store Partner explicitly overrides the rejection via a manual quality validation process after confirming the item is still fit for sale
rules.if_violated: The system must automatically reject the Order Request and notify the customer of the inability to fulfill the order
rules.rationale: Delivering items nearing expiry risks quality failure, customer dissatisfaction, and potential regulatory non-compliance.

parameters.name: Nearing expiry threshold
parameters.description: The specific shelf-life limit that triggers an item flag

rules.name: Real-Time Inventory Deduction
rules.statement: Inventory quantities reserved by an automatic Order Request assignment must be immediately deducted from the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot.
rules.condition: Upon successful assignment of an Order Request to a Store Partner
exceptions: If the assignment is subsequently cancelled or the order is rejected before the fulfillment task begins
rules.if_violated: The system must prevent further Order Requests from being assigned to the same inventory units, leading to overselling
rules.rationale: Immediate deduction ensures accurate stock visibility and prevents selling items that are already committed to a specific order.

parameters.name: Inventory snapshot update latency
parameters.description: The maximum acceptable time for the deduction to reflect in the snapshot

rules.name: Expiry Alert Generation
rules.statement: The system must generate real-time alerts for inventory items approaching their shelf-life limits to prioritize fulfillment or trigger removal.
rules.condition: When an item's remaining shelf life falls below the configured safety margin
exceptions: During system maintenance windows where alerting is temporarily suspended
rules.if_violated: The business loses the opportunity to proactively manage waste, potentially leading to increased loss costs and quality issues
rules.rationale: Proactive alerts enable timely decision-making to either sell items before they expire or remove them from the catalog.

parameters.name: Alert trigger threshold
parameters.description: The time or percentage remaining before an alert is generated

rules.name: Mandatory Status Notification Trigger
rules.statement: The system must automatically send a multi-channel notification to the customer when an order status transitions to 'Ready for Delivery' or 'Assigned to Delivery Partner'.
rules.condition: upon successful state transition to Ready for Delivery or Assigned to Delivery Partner
exceptions: Customer has explicitly opted out of all notifications
Customer has previously indicated 'Do Not Disturb' preference for this order type
rules.if_violated: Customer support inquiries increase and customer retention rates decline due to lack of transparency
rules.rationale: Timely transparency reduces customer anxiety and prevents unnecessary support tickets regarding order location.

parameters.name: notification_delay_threshold
parameters.description: maximum allowed time in seconds between status change and notification dispatch

rules.name: Notification Content Integrity
rules.statement: A status notification must only contain the current status, a concise description of the change, and the expected time window for the next action.
rules.condition: at the moment of notification generation
rules.if_violated: Customer confusion increases due to ambiguous or incomplete information
rules.rationale: Clear, consistent messaging ensures customers understand the delivery progress without needing to contact support.

parameters.name: max_message_length
parameters.description: maximum character count allowed in the notification body

rules.name: Delivery Partner Assignment Confirmation
rules.statement: The system must not trigger an 'Assigned to Delivery Partner' notification until the Delivery Partner has explicitly accepted the task.
rules.if_violated: Customer receives notification for a task the driver has not yet accepted, leading to false expectations and complaints
rules.rationale: Notifications must reflect only confirmed operational states to maintain trust and accuracy.

parameters.name: assignment_timeout_duration
parameters.description: maximum time allowed for a partner to accept a task before auto-rejection

rules.name: Notification Delivery Reliability
rules.statement: The system must ensure that a notification is successfully delivered via at least one configured channel within the maximum allowed duration.
exceptions: System-wide service outage declared by the Platform Operator
rules.if_violated: Customer remains uninformed despite the status change, negating the value of the notification feature
rules.rationale: Reliability is critical; if one channel fails, the customer must still be informed via an alternative method.

parameters.name: max_notification_retry_attempts
parameters.description: number of times the system retries sending the notification before marking it as failed
